Paid for by a contribution, Reference: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the release design design changes median real wealth by $-825,718 to $222,503; at the main row, $-41,844 (seed interval $-44,670 to $-39,124). Paid for by a contribution, Adverse: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the release design design changes median real wealth by $-210,618 to $121,287; no material change in median real wealth at the main row ($-13,436; materiality $13,787) (seed interval $-15,431 to $-11,467). Paid for by a contribution, Stress: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the release design design changes median real wealth by $-210,618 to $50,966; no material change in median real wealth at the main row ($1,429; materiality $13,787) (seed interval $81 to $2,777).
svg.title: Median real wealth (weighted, year-0 dollars): the release design against no programme, 40 years
svg.text: Median real wealth (weighted, year-0 dollars): the release design against no programme, 40 years
Each dot is one preregistered reading, sorted by its effect, with its 95% seed interval (unit: $).
Ringed: the main row. Diamond: the least-favourable bound. Shaded: not material (rule 3). Below each panel: the curve's verdict (rule 2).
Paid for by the Source (main row: full backing, a design parameter)
